stem.text: The diagram shows a simple circuit.

stem.alt: Simple circuit with a battery, a switch labelled S, and a resistor labelled R in a single loop.

A.text: When switch S is closed, the e.m.f. of the battery falls because work is done against the internal resistance of the battery.

B.text: When switch S is closed, the e.m.f. of the battery falls because work is done against the resistance of R.

C.text: When switch S is closed, the potential difference across the battery falls because work is done against the internal resistance of the battery.

D.text: When switch S is closed, the potential difference across the battery falls because work is done against the resistance of R.
